roi.description: Supported types and values: array of four integers [x, y, width, height] in capture-local pixels; or string Mermaid node ID such as "Find-Panel". Default: [0, 0, 0, 0] (whole frame). Other arrays need positive width and height. A string requires an earlier matched node with a box on the same window/monitor; its box is mapped into this frame before roi_offset. Independent single-node tests cannot resolve it.

oneOf.description: Supported types and values for roi: array of four integers [x,y,width,height] in capture-local pixels OR string Mermaid node ID such as "Find-Panel". Selected type: array. Default: [0,0,0,0] (whole frame); other arrays need positive width and height.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**All supported ROI types**

- **Array of four integers:** `[x,y,width,height]` in capture-local pixels (**selected type**).
- **String:** `"Find-Panel"` — earlier matched Mermaid node's box on the same target.

**Default:** `[0,0,0,0]` means the full frame. Other arrays need positive width and height.

prefixItems.title: x

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical start of the recognition area in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: width
prefixItems.description: Recognition-area width in captured-image pixels. Must be positive unless all four ROI values are zero.

prefixItems.title: height
prefixItems.description: Recognition-area height in captured-image pixels. Must be positive unless all four ROI values are zero.

oneOf.description: Supported types and values for roi: array of four integers [x,y,width,height] in capture-local pixels OR string Mermaid node ID such as "Find-Panel". Selected type: string. The node must have matched earlier on the same target, exist, and not reference itself. Default: [0,0,0,0] (whole frame).
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**All supported ROI types**

- **Array of four integers:** `[x,y,width,height]` in capture-local pixels.
- **String:** `"Find-Panel"` — earlier matched Mermaid node's box on the same target (**selected type**).

The box is mapped into the current frame before `roi_offset`. Self-references and unknown IDs are invalid. **Default:** `[0,0,0,0]`.

roi.markdownDescription:
**All supported ROI types**

- **Array of four integers:** `[x,y,width,height]` in capture-local pixels. Width/height must be positive except for `[0,0,0,0]`.
- **String Mermaid node ID:** `"Find-Panel"` — an earlier matched Mermaid node's box on the same window or monitor, mapped into this frame.

**Default:** `[0,0,0,0]` — complete encoded frame.

`roi_offset` adds to x, y, width, and height **after** either source resolves. Partially overlapping ROIs are clipped; missing boxes, other targets, and empty or non-overlapping ROIs fail immediately. Independent single-node tests cannot resolve earlier-node references.

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.description: Supported object types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Determines whether the node matches and may provide a detected box used by actions. roi, roi_offset, and candidate_selection belong inside this object. Default at node level: {"type":"DirectHit"}.

oneOf.title: Direct hit
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected DirectHit: always matches; useful with a fixed action target. Node default: DirectHit.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: DirectHit, which always matches and returns the effective ROI as its box. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `DirectHit` — always matches and returns the effective ROI as its box.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

roi.description: Supported values: [x,y,width,height] in capture-local pixels OR an earlier Mermaid node ID (e.g. "Find-Panel"). The earlier node must have a matched box on the same target. roi_offset applies after resolving either form. DirectHit returns the effective ROI as its box. Default: [0,0,0,0], the whole frame.
roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

- `[x,y,width,height]` in captured-image pixels
- `"Find-Panel"` for an earlier successful recognition box on the same target

`roi_offset` applies after resolution. DirectHit returns the effective ROI as its box. **Default:** `[0,0,0,0]`, the whole frame.

roi_offset.description: Supported value: [x_offset,y_offset,width_offset,height_offset] signed pixels, added to the fixed ROI or mapped earlier-node box before clipping. Default: [0,0,0,0].
roi_offset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

`[dx,dy,dwidth,dheight]` signed captured-image pixels. Add each component to the fixed ROI or mapped earlier-node box **before clipping**.

**Default:** `[0,0,0,0]`.

candidate_selection.description: Supported value: {order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}. Default: native order and index 0. DirectHit ignores this field.
candidate_selection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

{order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}.

**Default:** native order and index 0.

DirectHit ignores this field.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom.

**Selected DirectHit:** always matches; useful with a fixed action target.

**Node default:** DirectHit.

oneOf.title: Template match
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected TemplateMatch: find template-similar regions, filter by threshold, merge overlapping pixel-shift detections, then sort and select a distinct candidate.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: TemplateMatch, which locates regions similar to the configured template. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `TemplateMatch` — locate regions similar to the configured template.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

template.description: Supported value: non-empty image-path string. Required; no default. Absolute paths are used directly. Relative paths first check %USERPROFILE%/.watch_dog/resources/images and then bundled resources/images.

non-empty image-path string.

threshold.markdownDescription:

number from 0 through 1.

Minimum normalized template-match confidence.

roi.description: Supported values: [x,y,width,height] in capture-local pixels OR an earlier Mermaid node ID (e.g. "Find-Panel") with a matched box on the same target. roi_offset applies after resolution. Default: [0,0,0,0], search the whole frame.
roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

- `[x,y,width,height]` in captured-image pixels
- `"Find-Panel"` for an earlier successful recognition box on the same target

`roi_offset` applies after resolution. **Default:** `[0,0,0,0]`, search the whole frame.

roi_offset.description: Supported value: [x_offset,y_offset,width_offset,height_offset] signed pixels, added to the fixed ROI or mapped earlier-node box before clipping. Default: [0,0,0,0].
roi_offset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

`[dx,dy,dwidth,dheight]` signed captured-image pixels. Add each component to the fixed ROI or mapped earlier-node box **before clipping**.

**Default:** `[0,0,0,0]`.

candidate_selection.description: Supported value: {order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}. Sorts and selects one eligible template candidate. Default: native order and index 0.
candidate_selection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

{order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}.

Sorts and selects one eligible template candidate.

**Default:** native order and index 0.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom.

**Selected TemplateMatch:** find template-similar regions, filter by threshold, merge overlapping pixel-shift detections, then sort and select a distinct candidate. `candidate_selection.index` addresses this consolidated list.

oneOf.title: OCR
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected OCR: recognize text blocks, filter by confidence and optional expected regex, then sort and select a block.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: OCR, which recognizes text and filters it by expected regex and confidence. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `OCR` — recognize text and filter it by `expected` regex and confidence.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

expected.description: Supported value: string containing a Rust regular expression matched against each OCR block. Unanchored patterns search by substring; use ^...$ for an exact match. Literal spaces tolerate spaces omitted by OCR. Default: omitted, which accepts any text passing the confidence threshold.
expected.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

string containing a Rust regular expression matched against each OCR block.

Unanchored patterns search by substring; use ^...$ for an exact match.

Literal spaces tolerate spaces omitted by OCR.

**Default:** omitted, which accepts any text passing the confidence threshold.

threshold.description: Supported value: number from 0 through 1. Minimum OCR confidence. Default: 0.3.
threshold.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

number from 0 through 1.
